description: Caelo: free, local security scanner for apps built with AI coding tools. Finds exposed keys, browser-leaked secrets, open Firebase or Supabase rules, and committed .env files. CLI plus MCP server.
notes: Caelo is installed globally with npm (it is an npm-based CLI, not a standalone binary).
Run as an MCP server:  caelo --mcp
Caelo runs entirely on your machine: it reads files, uploads nothing, and redacts secret values.
The 'caelo' command is provided by npm's global bin, which the nodejs dependency adds to PATH.

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { abort 'caelo: ''npm install -g caelo'' failed. Ensure Node.js is installed (scoop install nodejs) and on PATH.' }
